## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Added a test that fails without this change (for behaviour changes)

- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
